text:
deploy-bot: HOTPATCH REQUEST v2026.3.1 -> eu-west1
deploy-bot: reason=embeddings service returning 502/503 for short requests, error spike since 00:18 UTC, impact=customer-facing search and recommendations, risk=high
emma: seeing the same in dashboards, top-level error rate +8% for embeddings endpoint in eu-west1 :rotating_light:
priya: oncall here. Logs show OOMs on embed-worker-3, kernel oom_killer lines: \"Killed process 2143 (python) total-vm:2048000kB\"
rj_oncall: looks like quantized model instance hitting mem pressure after recent quant kernel change (rollout 2026.3.0). We should pin to 2026.2.9 for eu pools and push hotfix build asap
lydia: product impact - search relevance degrades intermittently. Customers pinging support. Need short ETA and rollback decision, pls
emma: can we fast-track a rollback of canary -> stable? We already have 2026.2.9 container available in registry
marco: I can run the rollback and pin, but need approvals for expedited window (outside normal 01:00-03:00). Anyone from infra or release OK?
jen: I approve emergency rollback for eu-west1. :thumbsup: Prioritize minimal blast radius (single pool) and keep canary traffic for other regions
priya: ops checklist: 1) set image tag to 2026.2.9 on eu-west1 pool 2) drain embed-worker-3 nodes 3) monitor 30m 4) rollback if error rate not improving by 10m after shift
priya: commands to run: \n```\nrbctl set-image embed-pool-eu eu-west1 embed-service:2026.2.9 --force\nrbctl drain node embed-worker-3\n```\nemma: add release note line: \"Emergency rollback to 2026.2.9 in eu-west1 to mitigate embeddings OOMs introduced in 2026.3.0\"
marco: doing step 1 now, tagging with release tag and updating route table. Starting with pool-a to limit impact
deploy-bot: DEPLOY STARTED: rollout_id=hotpatch-1728394000, target=embed-pool-eu, strategy=staggered-pool-a-first
priya: monitoring metrics dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/graphs/embed-errors-eu (watching 5m error rate)
jen: confirm telemetry hooks enabled and keep trace sampling high for next 15m
marco: pool-a update finished, serving 2026.2.9. No immediate regressions in latency. Error rate down ~35% on pool-a
lydia: thanks team. Can we keep this as pinned image until Monday 08:00 UTC? Product requests extra time to validate regressions on search
emma: need stakeholder vote to keep pinned beyond normal change window. I can keep it pinned but want signoff from SRE and release
priya: SRE OK to pin until Monday 08:00 UTC, but require a follow-up postmortem and root cause once stable
rj_oncall: agreed. Also schedule a rollback plan in case new regressions appear after pinning. Set automatic rollback to 2026.3.0 disabled for eu until manual confirm
marco: set pin flag: `rbctl pin-image embed-pool-eu eu-west1 embed-service:2026.2.9 --until 2026-05-03T08:00:00Z`
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK RULE UPDATED: auto-fallback disabled for embed-pool-eu in eu-west1
emma: I'm drafting release note and incident stub. Will send postmortem template to #postmortems once stable
jen: thanks everyone. If error rate drops below baseline and stays for 30m, we can close hotpatch. Otherwise, escalate to infra for deeper kernel/quant regression rollback
priya: monitoring shows steady improvement. Marking watch window 40m from now.
marco: all done from ops side. Leaving notes in runbook and linking to the deploy id: hotpatch-1728394000
lydia: customer comms: I'll ask support to mark affected customers and send a proactive note once we have 30m stable
emma: closing note: expedited approval collected in-thread (jen, priyA, rj_oncall). Moving to postmortem after stability confirmed. :white_check_mark:
